info.title: sporegram
info.author: fungalspores
info.description: Unofficial Telegram client for Nintendo Switch
info.details:
Sporegram is a Telegram client for a Switch running custom firmware. Not a bridge and not a bot: the console talks to Telegram's servers over MTProto itself.

Features
- QR sign-in from your phone, two-step password supported
- Chats, groups, channels, folders and archive in two panes: list and conversation on one screen
- Replies, editing, deleting, forwarding, reactions, bot buttons, spoilers, quotes, premium emoji
- Photos, albums and video right in the chat; video plays on the console
- Send screenshots and clips from the console album, filtered by game with real game names
- Voice messages: record, send, play, transcribe (Telegram Premium)
- Voice calls with the four-emoji key check
- Stickers: static, animated and video
- Proxy: SOCKS5, HTTP and MTProto (dd and fake-TLS ee), right on the sign-in screen
- Up to four accounts, each with its own session and cache
- Russian and English
- Touch in handheld and the pad everywhere; 720p and 1080p
- Session file encrypted and bound to the console, optional passcode

You need your own Telegram API key from my.telegram.org in sdmc:/switch/sporegram/api.txt; the app writes a template and shows the steps on screen.

For voice messages and calls you need a headset with a microphone.

A port of AAhead by Alex Gakh (Memetrix), GPL-3.0.

changelog:
v2.0
- Redesigned interface: no full-width top bar, connection status in the chat list header, compact section tabs, denser rows, delivery ticks in the list
- Button bar shows at most four hints; minus opens a panel with every binding
- Settings rework: taller rows, value pills, switches
- Proxy support: SOCKS5, HTTP CONNECT and MTProto (plain, dd, fake-TLS ee), tg://proxy links, proxy.txt, available on the sign-in screen (Y)
- Sign-in no longer waits for a button: QR refreshes itself, revoked sessions start a new sign-in, dropped login connections resume
- Fixed a two-step password being submitted as a phone number after a reconnect
- Revoked or deleted accounts disappear from Settings; Y Y removes a slot; ZL/ZR switches accounts on the sign-in screen

v1.0
First public release.
